dedupe_keys.name: transport victoria open data portal victoria australia

description: The Transport Victoria open data portal gives access to Victorian transport datasets for anyone. Its news on 2026-09-29 listed releases such as telemetry traffic counts and vehicle classification (23 July 2026), TIRTL traffic counts and vehicle classification (9 March 2026), and changes to regional train and Yarra Trams travel information feeds (October and September 2025). Coverage: public transport, roads and traffic in Victoria, including Melbourne. Format and access: downloadable datasets and feeds. Licence and cost: free, with terms per dataset. Caveats: the home page is a portal front; contents and licences must be checked per dataset, and feed changes are announced as news. It supports network flow and capacity planning with counts and timetable data. It relates to the Transport for NSW hub and the Victoria bicycle infrastructure network in the catalogue.
